products.name: Martex® Basics Comforter
products.description:
Formerly branded as Martex Rx. Encompassing our best-selling institutional products for the military, group housing, and healthcare facilities, this program brings together bedding in a variety of products and colors for your customers' use . Where durability and comfort collide for hospitality-grade products that are economical and TAA Compliant for GSA® Contracts.

Available in an array of neutral colors , they seamlessly coordinate with a wide range of color palettes to create a sharp, stylish impression that guests will remember. Whether updating a single room or outfitting an entire property, Martex ® Basics delivers long-lasting performance and timeless style.
